listing.summary: Faces in the Void replaces all vanilla human portraits in Starsector. At this time, it also adds 123 additional generic NPC portraits. This is a work-in-progress with portraits being tweaked and replaced. Also, more bonus portraits will be added over time.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces all vanilla human portraits and adds 123 additional generic NPC portraits.

description:
Download Link:https://github.com/Moffhul/Starsector-Faces-in-the-Void/releases/download/v0.6-Faces-in-the-Void/Faces.in.the.Void_v0.6-beta.zip

All images are AI-generated.

Images were created using Midjourney AI and the vanilla portrait assets.
While I've put a lot of work into this and am proud of this mod so far, I make no claims of being an artist.
I just work with technology, have fiddled with AI, love this game and wanted to share.

Faces in the Void replaces all vanilla human portraits in Starsector. At this time, it also adds 123 additional generic NPC portraits.
This is a work-in-progress with portraits being tweaked and replaced. Also, more bonus portraits will be added over time.

v0.6 the Persean League Resupplied
v0.6 includes 32 bonus portraits exclusive to the Persean League and updates the Reynard Hannan portrait. Also, 9 addition Hegemony and 4 additional Tri Tachyon portraits were added.

New League sheet:

Spoiler

v0.6 update notes

Spoiler
v0.6-beta 10/17/26
NEW PORTRAITS:
Persean League: Added 18 male and 14 female bonus portraits.
Hegemony:  Added an additional 7 male and 5 female bonus portraits, bringing the total to 18 male and 15 female.
Tri-Tachyon: Added 2 more male and female bonus portraits each, bringing the total to 7 female and 9 male. When I first started the bonus portraits, the total of 12 seemed like a lot...

EDITED:
Removed background bloom from some more portraits (every time I think I got them all, I spot another...)

I plan to release the bonus portraits for both the Luddic Church and Luddic Path together in the next update.

This is the first mod I've ever released to others. Feedback is welcome.

Current portraits included in the mod:

Tri-tachyon and the Sindrian Diktat
